STEADY DROP · iOS

Privacy Policy

Last updated: October 31, 2026

This policy explains how 北京玄鸟智序科技有限责任公司 (Beijing Xuanniao Zhixu Technology Co., Ltd., “we”, “us”) handles personal information when you use Hexa Landing (installed as Steady Drop), our physics puzzle game, and contact us about the game.

1. Information we process

  • Account information: your email address, account identifier, authentication records, and information supplied through Sign in with Apple, such as an Apple account identifier and an email address, which may be a private relay address. Email registration and password sign-in are processed through Supabase Authentication. Authentication emails are delivered using Alibaba Cloud DirectMail.
  • Game and reward records: your life balance, life points, time zone used for daily replenishment, level numbers, round identifiers and outcomes, timestamps, and ad reward verification records. Our servers use these records to operate the life system and prevent duplicate or fraudulent rewards.
  • Information stored on your device: game progress and preferences, pending round information, and authentication session credentials. Session credentials are stored in the iOS Keychain.
  • Technical and advertising information: our hosting and service providers may process IP addresses and request logs. Google Mobile Ads may process IP addresses (including to estimate general location), device and advertising identifiers where available and permitted, ad interactions, diagnostic information, and performance data for advertising, measurement, security, and fraud prevention. Consent choices are processed through Google's User Messaging Platform (UMP).
  • Support information: information you choose to include in emails to us.

The game does not request access to your contacts, camera, microphone, photo library, or precise device location. This does not prevent advertising providers from estimating general location from an IP address.

2. How we use information

We use information to register and authenticate accounts; operate the game, daily lives, and rewards; verify completed rewarded advertisements; prevent misuse; troubleshoot problems; respond to requests; and meet applicable obligations. Advertisements help fund the game. Rewarded advertisements are offered when you choose to watch an ad for a life; a reward requires successful completion and verification.

3. Providers and disclosures

We use Supabase for authentication, databases, and backend functions; Apple for Sign in with Apple; Alibaba Cloud DirectMail for authentication email delivery; and Google AdMob and UMP for advertising and privacy choices. These providers process information according to their roles and applicable terms. We may also disclose information when reasonably necessary to comply with applicable law, protect rights and security, or as part of a business transfer subject to appropriate protections.

Google processes advertising information under its own policies. Read Google's Privacy Policy and how Google uses information from apps that use its services. Additional information is available from Supabase, Apple, and Alibaba Cloud.

4. Advertising and your choices

For the first public release of Hexa Landing, we request non-personalized advertisements. We do not request App Tracking Transparency permission or access to Apple's advertising identifier (IDFA). We disable Google's publisher first-party ID and apply non-personalized ad request settings. These restrictions do not prevent the processing of technical and advertising information described above for ad delivery, aggregated reporting, diagnostics, security, and fraud prevention.

Where required, we request privacy choices through Google UMP before requesting advertisements. Depending on your location and the options available, you may consent, decline, or manage relevant advertising purposes and partners. An “Ad privacy choices” entry is available in the game when required. Non-personalized ads may still require consent for device storage or similar technologies; choosing not to consent does not necessarily remove all advertisements, and ad availability may be limited.

5. Grounds for processing

Where applicable law requires a legal basis, we process information as necessary to provide the service you request, for legitimate interests such as security and service reliability subject to your rights, to comply with legal obligations, and on the basis of consent where required for advertising or similar technologies. You may withdraw consent through the available privacy controls; withdrawal does not affect processing already performed lawfully.

6. Storage, retention, and international processing

Account and game service records are retained while needed to operate your account and the game. Security, support, and reward verification records may be retained as necessary to investigate misuse, resolve disputes, and meet applicable obligations. We do not currently apply a single fixed retention period to all records. Providers may apply their own retention schedules, and deleted records may remain in backups until those backups expire under the provider's processes.

We operate from China and use international service providers. Your information may be processed outside your country of residence, including where our providers operate. Where applicable, appropriate safeguards are required for restricted international transfers.

7. Security

We use HTTPS for communication with the game backend, iOS Keychain storage for session credentials, and account access controls for backend records. No system can guarantee absolute security.

8. Your rights and account deletion

Depending on your location, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, or obtain a copy of your personal information, restrict or object to certain processing, and withdraw consent. You may also complain to your local data protection authority.

You can delete your account in the game through Settings → Delete account after reauthentication. For privacy requests or to request deletion of your account and associated server records by email, contact chandler@epanda.com.cn with the subject “Steady Drop Privacy Request” and identify the account concerned. Do not send your password or verification code. We may ask for information reasonably needed to verify your identity. Some information may need to be retained for legal, security, or dispute-related reasons. Uninstalling the game does not itself delete your server account; some Keychain information may also persist on the device.

9. Children

We do not knowingly collect personal information from children below the minimum age at which they can consent to the relevant processing under applicable law without any required authorization. If you believe a child has provided information improperly, contact us so we can investigate and take appropriate action.

10. Changes and contact

We may update this policy as the game or its data practices change. We will update the date above and provide additional notice where required.
